meeting_in_a_minute.name: Meeting in a minute
meeting_in_a_minute.best_for: County commission, city council, school board and planning board meetings with several actions.
meeting_in_a_minute.voice: Direct, civic, useful and complete enough that a resident understands what happened.
script_slots: Lead with the biggest decision.
Give the number or reason behind it.
Say how the vote went, if there was debate.
Name the next public hearing, deadline or follow-up.
Include one spending item.
Include one services item.
Include one grant, appointment or recognition.
End with where to read the full recap.
meeting_in_a_minute.ending: Read the full meeting recap at neusenews.com.

crime_story.name: Crime story
crime_story.best_for: Arrests, charges, traffic stops, investigations, court updates and public safety releases.
crime_story.voice: Clear and careful. Tell what officials said, name charges accurately, and include an allegation reminder.
script_slots: Lead with what officials say happened.
Name who was charged, if published.
Give the location and agency.
Add the public-safety context or why readers asked about it.
State that charges are allegations unless proven in court.
End with where to read the full story.
crime_story.ending: Read the full story at neusenews.com.

news_story.name: News story
news_story.best_for: General local updates, schools, roads, business, weather, deadlines, public notices and service changes.
news_story.voice: Plainspoken, fast and useful. Tell residents what changed and what to do next.
script_slots: Lead with the main news.
Say who is affected.
Give the date, place or amount.
Explain what changes next.
Tell readers what action to take, if any.
End with where to read the full story.
news_story.ending: Read the full story at neusenews.com.

featured_story.name: Featured story
featured_story.best_for: Profiles, community features, students, volunteers, small businesses, arts, sports and human-interest stories.
featured_story.voice: Warm but still reported. Lead with the person, then show why the story matters locally.
script_slots: Lead with the person and what they did.
Give the local connection.
Add the turning point or reason the story matters now.
Include a quote, detail or scene from the story.
Explain the broader community connection.
End with where to read the full feature.
featured_story.ending: Read the full feature at neusenews.com.
